name: Philips India
description: Philips India Limited is an unlisted Indian operating subsidiary of Dutch health-technology and consumer electronics conglomerate Koninklijke Philips N.V.

stock.note: Philips India Limited is an unlisted entity; parent company Koninklijke Philips N.V. trades on Euronext Amsterdam under ticker PHIA.AS and NYSE as PHG.

marketing_spend.derivation: Modeled using a standard 3-5% consumer tech marketing-to-revenue benchmark applied against Philips India's operating scale and reported FY2024-25 Profit After Tax (PAT) of ~₹309 crore.
